alternatives.question:
I didn't even start playing football until I was 14, originally taking it up just to stay in shape for basketball and baseball.
Yet I went on to become the first goalkeeper in New England Revolution history to be named MLS Goalkeeper of the Year.
I've since played under Mikel Arteta & Nuno Espírito Santo.

In 2013, I was featured as the number one worst play of the day on ESPN for scoring an own goal.
Yet I've since won the FA Cup in 2025.
I've played with Ødegaard, Elanga & Thomas Partey.

At the 2022 World Cup I played every minute of my country's campaign and kept two clean sheets.
This made me the first American goalkeeper to do so in a single tournament since 1930.
I've shared a pitch with the likes of Saka, Gibbs-White & Guéhi.
